title: What a digit is worth depends on its place
concept: A digit is worth different amounts in different places. In a two-digit number the first digit counts tens and the second counts ones.
'The value of a digit' is how much it is worth (a tens digit is worth that many tens); 'how many tens' is just the count. The same digit answers the two questions differently.
